headlines.title_en: Wall Street Snacks Breakfast | August 11, 2026
headlines.summary_en: Tech stocks dragged down U.S. equities, with the S&P 500 and Dow pulling back from record highs; Nvidia fell nearly 3%, optical communications stock Coherent dropped over 10%; Chinese ADRs rose against the trend, with Alibaba up 3%; crude oil rose over 5% intraday, European natural gas gained over 10%; the yen briefly fell 1%, and offshore yuan temporarily left three-year highs. Trump demanded Iran pay compensation and be included in all future negotiations, claiming U.S. forces have "100% control" of the Strait of Hormuz; Iran made密集 personnel changes, with the Supreme Leader appointing six senior military commanders. U.S. strategic petroleum reserves fell below 300 million barrels for the first time since 1983. Trump denied frequent calls with Warsh: only one conversation since Warsh took office. Report: BOJ signal of a September rate hike prompted U.S. to join currency intervention. South Korea announced a new 5 trillion won fund focused on semiconductor materials and equipment.

headlines.title: China’s factory-gate prices growth slows to 3.5% in July amid lower fuel prices
headlines.summary:
China’s factory-gate prices growth slowed in July, as lower domestic fuel prices eased cost pressures triggered by the US-Israel war on Iran, while high temperatures dragged manufacturing.
The producer price index (PPI) rose by 3.5 per cent year on year last month, compared with 4.1 per cent in June, according to data released by the National Bureau of Statistics (NBS) on Sunday.

headlines.summary: 据中国人民银行内蒙古自治区分行消息，近日，在人民银行内蒙古自治区分行指导推动下，全区首笔“再贴现+汇率避险”业务在中国（内蒙古）自由贸易试验区二连浩特片区成功落地。加之6月26日已成功落地的“再贷款+汇率避险”业务，标志着“再贷款+再贴现”双轮驱动的外贸金融支持体系初步形成，本外币合力支持外贸高质量发展的动能进一步增强。

headlines.title_en: Inner Mongolia's First 'Rediscounting + FX Hedging' Transaction Successfully Completed
headlines.summary_en: According to the Inner Mongolia Branch of the People's Bank of China (PBOC), recently, under its guidance, the region's first "rediscount plus FX hedging" business was successfully landed in the Erlianhot area of the China (Inner Mongolia) Pilot Free Trade Zone. Combined with the "relending plus FX hedging" business that landed on June 26, this marks the initial formation of a foreign trade financial support system driven by both "relending and rediscount," further enhancing the momentum of combined domestic and foreign currency support for high-quality foreign trade development.

headlines.title: 中国商务部: 自巴西进口的牛肉已达到保障措施规定数量的90%
headlines.summary: 中国商务部公告称，牛肉保障措施项下自巴西进口的牛肉于2026年8月10日已达到商务部公告2025年第87号明确的该国家（地区）规定数量的90%。根据商务部公告2025年第87号，在牛肉进口数量达到规定数量100%的第3日起（含当日），将在现行适用关税税率基础上加征55%关税。

headlines.title_en: China's Ministry of Commerce: Beef Imports from Brazil Reach 90% of Safeguard Measure Threshold
headlines.summary_en: China's Ministry of Commerce announced that beef imported from Brazil under the safeguard measure has reached 90% of the specified amount for that country (region) as clarified in Announcement No. 87 of 2025, effective August 10, 2026. According to Announcement No. 87 of 2025, starting from the 3rd day after beef import volume reaches 100% of the specified amount (including that day), a 55% tariff will be added on top of the current applicable tariff rate.

headlines.summary_zh: 仲量联行的数据显示，香港第二季度商业地产投资额增加超过一倍，达到31亿美元，成为亚太地区增长最快的投资市场，这得益于零售和写字楼交易的强劲增长以及低基数效应。129%的同比增长超过了新加坡等其他表现优异的市场。

headlines.title: What makes McDonald’s assets stand out amid a weak Hong Kong retail property market?
headlines.summary:
One year after McDonald’s began selling its self-owned Hong Kong shops, the fast-food giant has found buyers for nearly half its portfolio even as the city’s retail property market endures its weakest spell in decades.
McDonald’s planned to dispose of all 23 shops in phases, market sources said, with the portfolio initially valued at about HK$3 billion (US$382 million).

headlines.title_zh: 在香港零售物业市场疲软之际，麦当劳的资产有何突出之处？
headlines.summary_zh: 麦当劳开始出售其自有的香港门店一年后，这家快餐巨头已为其近半资产组合找到了买家，尽管香港零售物业市场正经历数十年来最疲弱的时期。据市场消息人士称，麦当劳计划分阶段出售全部23家门店，该资产组合初始估值约为30亿港元（约合3.85亿美元）。

headlines.title: 深圳市与沃尔玛中国签署战略合作框架协议
headlines.summary: 据深视新闻，8月11日，深圳市人民政府与沃尔玛（中国）投资有限公司签署战略合作框架协议。根据协议，双方将在总部经济提质扩容、全域全业态商业网络布局、门店数字化升级与促消费联动、跨境电商与进出口等多领域开展战略合作。

headlines.title_en: Shenzhen and Walmart China Sign Strategic Cooperation Framework Agreement
headlines.summary_en: According to Shenzhen TV News, on August 11, the Shenzhen Municipal People's Government signed a strategic cooperation framework agreement with Walmart (China) Investment Co., Ltd. Under the agreement, the two sides will conduct strategic cooperation in areas such as upgrading and expanding headquarters economy, full-domain and all-format commercial network layout, store digital upgrades linked with consumption promotion, cross-border e-commerce and import/export.

headlines.title: 研报掘金丨中邮证券：伟星新材在行业需求下行阶段表现韧性，盈利能力稳定
headlines.summary: 中邮证券研报指出，行业需求持续承压，伟星新材盈利能力彰显韧性。26上半年实现归母净利润3.9亿元，同比+43.9%，其中26Q2归母净利润2.7亿元，同比+72.0%。公司归母净利润与扣非净利润增速差异主要因为，上半年公司对东鹏合立的投资收益1.2亿元及收购北京松田程公司股权产生的利得0.27亿元等非经常性损益。公司在行业需求下行阶段表现韧性，盈利能力稳定，通过水生态系统业务布局增加客单价，不断夯实竞争力。

headlines.title_en: Research Report | Zhongtai Securities: Weixing New Materials Shows Resilience Amid Industry Demand Downturn with Stable Profitability
headlines.summary_en: China Post Securities research report: Industry demand remains under pressure, but Vasona Pipe Industry shows profitability resilience. H1 2026 net profit attributable to parent was 390 million yuan, up 43.9% YoY, with Q2 net profit of 270 million yuan, up 72.0% YoY. The difference between net profit and non-GAAP net profit growth is mainly due to non-recurring items including investment income of 120 million yuan from Dongpeng Heli and gains of 27 million yuan from acquiring Beijing Songtiancheng shares. The company shows resilience during industry demand downturn, stable profitability, and enhances competitiveness through water ecosystem business layout to increase customer ticket size.

headlines.title_en: Caitong Fuxin Open-End Mixed Fund: Trading Halted from Afternoon Open to Close on August 11
headlines.summary_en: Caitong Fund Management Co., Ltd. announced that as of the midday close of the Shanghai Stock Exchange on August 11, 2026, the secondary market trading price of its Caitong Duoce Fuxin Fixed-Term Open Flexible Allocation Hybrid Fund (short name: Caitong Fuxin Fixed-Term Open Hybrid, code: 501046) is severely higher than its NAV, showing extreme premium. Investors are cautioned about the premium risk in secondary market trading prices; blind investment may result in significant losses. To protect investor interests, the fund will halt trading from the afternoon open on August 11, 2026, until market close.

headlines.title: 中信证券：北交所流动性走势有望在政策催化下迎来拐点
headlines.summary: 中信证券研报称，在北交所政策持续优化的背景下，资本运作活跃，再融资简易程序直击创新型中小企业“融资难、融资慢”痛点。并且北交所流动性触底回升，中信证券认为当前北交所指数流动性处于较低位置，有可能处于估值底、情绪底。

headlines.title_en: CITIC Securities: BSE liquidity trend expected to see turning point amid policy catalysts
headlines.summary_en: CITIC Securities research report: Amid continued policy optimization on the Beijing Stock Exchange (BSE), capital operations are active, with simplified refinancing procedures directly addressing the "difficult and slow financing" pain points of innovative SMEs. Additionally, BSE liquidity has bottomed out and is recovering; CITIC Securities believes the current BSE index liquidity is at a low level, possibly indicating a valuation and sentiment bottom.

headlines.title_en: RBA Holds Rates Steady for Second Consecutive Meeting to Assess Developments
headlines.summary_en: Despite inflation still well above target, the RBA kept rates unchanged for the second consecutive meeting, in line with economist and market expectations. Although renewed Middle East conflict pushed oil prices up again, lower-than-expected inflation data in late July dampened August rate hike expectations, giving the committee more breathing room to monitor developments in the Strait of Hormuz. The RBA's economic forecasts show it still expects inflation to stay above 2.5% until early 2028. Another consideration is the rapidly deteriorating property market, which could weigh on household consumption and further weaken economic momentum. After three rate hikes in the first half, home prices have begun to fall, but the downturn has accelerated since federal budget tightened tax incentives for property investors.
